name: hwcloud-obs
title: Huawei Object Storage Service (OBS)
description: To provide stable, secure, efficient, and easy-to-use cloud storage service on Huawei Cloud
label: cloud

properties.name: operation
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Operation to be performed

properties.name: bucketName
properties.description: Name of bucket to perform operation on

properties.name: endpoint
properties.description: OBS url. Carries higher precedence than region parameter based client initialization

properties.name: objectName
properties.description: Name of object to perform operation with

properties.name: region
properties.description: OBS service region. This is lower precedence than endpoint based configuration

properties.name: deleteAfterRead
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Determines if objects should be deleted after it has been retrieved

properties.name: delimiter
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: The character used for grouping object names

properties.name: destinationBucket
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Name of destination bucket where objects will be moved when moveAfterRead is set to true

properties.name: fileName
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Get the object from the bucket with the given file name

properties.name: includeFolders
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: If true, objects in folders will be consumed. Otherwise, they will be ignored and no Exchanges will be created for them

properties.name: maxMessagesPerPoll
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: The maximum number of messages to poll at each polling

properties.name: moveAfterRead
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Determines whether objects should be moved to a different bucket after they have been retrieved. The destinationBucket option must also be set for this option to work.

properties.name: prefix
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: The object name prefix used for filtering objects to be listed

properties.name: sendEmptyMessageWhenIdle
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: If the polling consumer did not poll any files, you can enable this option to send an empty message (no body) instead.

properties.name: bridgeErrorHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exceptionHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exchangePattern
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

properties.name: pollStrategy
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: A pluggable org.apache.camel.PollingConsumerPollingStrategy allowing you to provide your custom implementation to control error handling usually occurred during the poll operation before an Exchange have been created and being routed in Camel.

properties.name: bucketLocation
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Location of bucket when creating a new bucket

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: proxyHost
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: Proxy server ip/hostname

properties.name: proxyPassword
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: Proxy authentication password

properties.name: proxyPort
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: Proxy server port

properties.name: proxyUser
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: Proxy authentication user

properties.name: backoffErrorThreshold
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: The number of subsequent error polls (failed due some error) that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

properties.name: backoffIdleThreshold
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: The number of subsequent idle polls that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

properties.name: backoffMultiplier
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: To let the scheduled polling consumer backoff if there has been a number of subsequent idles/errors in a row. The multiplier is then the number of polls that will be skipped before the next actual attempt is happening again. When this option is in use then backoffIdleThreshold and/or backoffErrorThreshold must also be configured.

properties.name: delay
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Milliseconds before the next poll.

properties.name: greedy
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: If greedy is enabled, then the ScheduledPollConsumer will run immediately again, if the previous run polled 1 or more messages.

properties.name: initialDelay
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Milliseconds before the first poll starts.

properties.name: repeatCount
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Specifies a maximum limit of number of fires. So if you set it to 1, the scheduler will only fire once. If you set it to 5, it will only fire five times. A value of zero or negative means fire forever.

properties.name: runLoggingLevel
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: The consumer logs a start/complete log line when it polls. This option allows you to configure the logging level for that.

properties.name: scheduledExecutorService
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Allows for configuring a custom/shared thread pool to use for the consumer. By default each consumer has its own single threaded thread pool.

properties.name: scheduler
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: To use a cron scheduler from either camel-spring or camel-quartz component. Use value spring or quartz for built in scheduler

properties.name: schedulerProperties
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: To configure additional properties when using a custom scheduler or any of the Quartz, Spring based scheduler. This is a multi-value option with prefix: scheduler.

properties.name: startScheduler
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Whether the scheduler should be auto started.

properties.name: timeUnit
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Time unit for initialDelay and delay options.

properties.name: useFixedDelay
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Controls if fixed delay or fixed rate is used. See ScheduledExecutorService in JDK for details.

properties.name: accessKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Access key for the cloud user

properties.name: ignoreSslVerification
properties.label: security
properties.description: Ignore SSL verification

properties.name: secretKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Secret key for the cloud user

properties.name: serviceKeys
properties.label: security
properties.description: Configuration object for cloud service authentication
